technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals with strong volume and oscillator reversals, but price remains below key moving averages and long-term trend is bearish; suitable for tactical swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: ADSK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 89 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — small to medium amounts, junior member
sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from Ro Khanna's May sales (94-112 days old) combined with market fear (40/100) and elevated bearish sentiment (42%) suggests contrarian buy setup, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional activity limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.2) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 89 days presents moderate event risk but secondary to acute macro deterioration.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical oversold bounce signals (stoch cross, stochRSI, OBV, 15x volume spike, supertrend) with price near support (212.82) offer tactical swing entry with defined risk in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro deterioration (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 315.2), price below all key moving averages (9/21/50/200), bearish long-term trend (EMA 50/200), high earnings risk in 89 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction overwhelm tactical technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical oversold bounce signals (stoch cross, volume spike 15x, supertrend) present tactical entry opportunity at support; however, macro environment deterioration and fundamental weakness do not justify entry at this time.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX crisis (315.2) signal acute recession risk that will likely overwhelm any tactical bounce; earnings in 89 days adds event risk during macro stress.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 50 positions in Information Technology sector; adding ADSK increases concentration risk during macro crisis without fundamental or institutional conviction to justify it.
